        //  2. it has been >= 50% in view, in a visible tab, for N seconds in total since it rendered
        //  3. it is in view now and has stayed in view for REFRESH_DWELL seconds (not being scrolled past)
        // Refreshed requests carry refresh=<n> targeting so they can be reported on in GAM.
        const REFRESH_INVIEW_RATIO = 0.5;
        const REFRESH_DWELL = 2;
        const refreshables = {};
        let refreshTicker = null;

        const refreshObserver = new IntersectionObserver(entries => entries.forEach(entry => {
            const state = refreshables[entry.target.id];
            if (state) {
                state.inView = entry.boundingClientRect.height > 0 && entry.intersectionRatio >= REFRESH_INVIEW_RATIO;
            }
        }), { threshold: [0, 0.25, REFRESH_INVIEW_RATIO, 0.75, 1] });

        function refreshTick() {
            const pageVisible = document.visibilityState === 'visible';
            for (const id in refreshables) {
                const state = refreshables[id];
                if (!state.armed) continue;
                if (!pageVisible || !state.inView || !state.element.isConnected) {
                    state.dwell = 0;
                    continue;
                }

                state.inViewSeconds++;
                state.dwell++;
                if ((state.viewable || state.empty) && state.inViewSeconds >= state.seconds && state.dwell >= REFRESH_DWELL) {
                    // Disarmed until slotRenderEnded re-arms it, so one refresh per render
                    state.armed = false;
                    state.count++;
                    state.slot.setTargeting('refresh', String(state.count));
                    console.log(new Date().toISOString().substr(11, 8) + ' %crefreshAd%c(' + id + ') #' + state.count + ' after ' + state.inViewSeconds + 's in view ' + state.slot.getAdUnitPath(), 'color: orange;', 'color: initial;');
                    googletag.pubads().refresh([state.slot]);
                }
            }
        }

        function armRefresh(e, element, seconds) {
            const id = element.id;
            let state = refreshables[id];
            if (!state) {
                state = refreshables[id] = { slot: e.slot, element: element, inView: false, count: 0 };
                refreshObserver.observe(element);
            }
            Object.assign(state, { armed: true, seconds: seconds, empty: e.isEmpty, viewable: false, inViewSeconds: 0, dwell: 0 });
            refreshTicker = refreshTicker || setInterval(refreshTick, 1000);
        }

        googletag.pubads().addEventListener('impressionViewable', (e) => {
            const id = e.slot.getSlotElementId();
            const element = document.getElementById(id);
            // data-rendered / data-viewable let page scripts (e.g. english/__js/_header.js) follow a slot's state
            if (element) element.dataset.viewable = 'true';
            const state = refreshables[id];
            if (state) state.viewable = true;
        });

        // Manual, ungated refresh for debugging from the console: refreshAd('div-gpt-ad-...') or refreshAd('/1029551/Dawn-...')
        window.refreshAd = id => googletag.pubads().refresh(
            googletag.pubads().getSlots().filter(slot => slot.getAdUnitPath() === id || slot.getSlotElementId() === id)
        );

        
        
        // <div data-refresh="30" id='div-gpt-ad-1234567890123-0' ...
        // https://developers.google.com/publisher-tag/reference#googletag.events.SlotRenderEndedEvent
        googletag.pubads().addEventListener("slotRenderEnded", (e) => {
            const id = e.slot.getSlotElementId();
            const element = document.getElementById(id);
            if (!element) return;

            const isFilled   = !e.isEmpty;
            const isDebug    = window.__debugAds;
            const hasSize    = e.size && (e.size[0] > 1 || e.size[1] > 1);
            const wantsFloat = element.dataset.floating === 'true' && typeof initFloatingAdUnit === 'function';

            element.dataset.rendered = isFilled ? 'filled' : 'empty';
            delete element.dataset.viewable;

            // Apply visual styling only to ads with real dimensions
            if (isFilled && hasSize) {
                element.classList.add('ad-rendered');
                const renderedClasses = (element.getAttribute('data-rendered-classes') || '').trim();
                if (renderedClasses) element.classList.add(...renderedClasses.split(/\s+/));
            }

            if (isFilled) {
                console.log(new Date().toISOString().substr(11, 8) + ' %cADVERT%c: ' + (e.size ? e.size[0] + ',' + e.size[1] : '1x1') + ' | Id: ' + id + ' | Path: ' + e.slot.getAdUnitPath() + ' | Advertiser: ' + e.advertiserId + ' | LineItem: ' + (e.lineItemId || 'Adx') + ' | Creative: ' + e.creativeId, 'color: orange;', 'color: initial;');
            } else if (isDebug) {
                console.log(new Date().toISOString().substr(11, 8) + ' %cADVERT%c: (empty/debug) | Id: ' + id + ' | Path: ' + e.slot.getAdUnitPath(), 'color: orange;', 'color: initial;');
            }

            if ((isFilled || isDebug) && wantsFloat) {
                initFloatingAdUnit(element);
            }

            // data-smart-refresh / data-refresh: (re)arm the viewability-gated refresh, see refreshTick()
            const seconds = parseInt(element.dataset.smartRefresh || element.dataset.refresh, 10);
            if (seconds > 0) {
                if (isDebug) {
                    console.log(new Date().toISOString().substr(11, 8) + ' %crefreshAd%c(' + id + ') armed: ' + seconds + 's in view ' + e.slot.getAdUnitPath(), 'color: orange;', 'color: initial;');
                }
                armRefresh(e, element, seconds);
            }
        });


        
        // create an array of rendered slots
        // this event is fired only for ads with content, no empty slots (SlotRenderEndedEvent)
        // https://developers.google.com/publisher-tag/reference#googletag.events.SlotOnloadEvent
        googletag.pubads().addEventListener('slotOnload', function(e) {
            const id = e.slot.getSlotElementId(); 
            const slot = document.getElementById(id);
            
            const parent = slot.closest('.ad-sticky-slide');
            if (parent) {
                const height = slot.getBoundingClientRect().height * 1.5;
                parent.style.width = '100%';
                parent.style.height = height + 'px';
                parent.style.backgroundColor = '#fafafa';
                parent.style.marginBottom = '16px';
            }
        });

        googletag.pubads().getSlots().forEach(slot => {
            const divId = slot.getSlotElementId();
            const div = document.getElementById(divId);
            // Prevent collapsing on data-collapse="false"
            if (div && div.dataset.collapse === 'false') {
                slot.setCollapseEmptyDiv(false);
            }
        });
        
        if (__debugAds) {
            function logEventDetails(name, e) {
                const id = e.slot.getSlotElementId(); 
                const slot = document.getElementById(id);
                const isEagerLoaded = slot.dataset.eager === "true";

                console.log('');
                console.log('=============== Event Details ' + name + ' ====================');
                console.log('[AdUnitPath]', e.slot.getAdUnitPath());
                console.log('[Id]', id);
                console.log('[EagerLoaded]', isEagerLoaded);
                console.log('[event]', e);
            }
            googletag.pubads().addEventListener('slotRequested', e => {
                logEventDetails('slotRequested', e);
            });
            googletag.pubads().addEventListener('slotRenderEnded', e => {
                logEventDetails('slotRenderEnded', e);
            });
            
            // debugging is enabled, add bgcolor and padding on all ad divs
            document.querySelectorAll('[id^="div-gpt-ad-"]').forEach(el => {
                var hasError = el.classList.contains('advert-error');
                el.style.backgroundColor = hasError ? '#ecc' : '#ccc';
                el.title = el.dataset.name || '';
                el.innerHTML = hasError ? el.dataset.name : '';
                if (hasError) {
                    el.style.padding = '10px';
                }
                el.style.height = el.dataset.height || '';
                el.style.width = el.dataset.width || '';

                var renderedClasses = (el.getAttribute('data-rendered-classes') || '').trim();
                if (renderedClasses) el.classList.add(...renderedClasses.split(/\s+/));
            });
        } else {
            googletag.pubads().collapseEmptyDivs();
        }
        
    });
    </script>

    <div dir='auto' class='story__content  flow-root    text-4 leading-tight text-black'><p><strong>Syria’s top diplomat on Saturday said Damascus was considering whether to join the Makkah defence alliance that binds Turkiye, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan.</strong></p>
<p>The Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, signed on August 7, 2026, by Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey, establishes a collective defence framework where an armed attack against any single member is treated as an attack against all three.</p>
<p>“Discussions are currently underway to evaluate Syria’s entry into the Makkah alliance,” Al Shaibani said at the Manama Dialogue conference in Bahrain.</p>
<p>Saudi Arabia, under heavy fire from Yemen’s Houthis, is a key backer of Syria’s government that came to power after the fall of former strongman Bashar al-Assad in December 2024.</p>
<p>Pakistan has two defence agreements with Saudi Arabia aimed at collective deterrence: the Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement between the two countries, and the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, which also includes Turkiye.</p>
<p>Pakistan is providing “whatever support is needed” to defend Saudi Arabia amid the Houthi attacks, military spokesperson Lieutenant General Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry said earlier this month.</p>
<p>However, the Inter-Services Public Relations director general also clarified that all members of the Makkah Defence Alliance were “absolutely clear… that this alliance has no offensive intent; it is purely defensive”.</p>
<p>On Friday, Lt-Gen Chaudhry said the wording of the pact did not bar new members, when asked whether Iran could join the agreement.</p>
<p>“Anyone who has a shared vision of collective deterrence and regional peace, why not? Everyone is most welcome,” he said, adding that it was for the political leadership of the three principal parties to decide.</p>
<p>Earlier this month, French President Emmanuel Macron made a surprise visit to Riyadh and said France had sent troops to help shield a key Saudi oil terminal from Houthi attacks.</p>
<p>Also in October, the UK government announced it would deploy British fighter planes to help Saudi Arabia against the attacks.</p>

headline: Syria weighing whether to join Makkah pact: foreign minister
description: Damascus says talks are underway on joining the alliance of Turkiye, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Syria’s top diplomat on Saturday said Damascus was considering whether to join the Makkah defence alliance that binds Turkiye, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan.

The Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, signed on August 7, 2026, by Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey, establishes a collective defence framework where an armed attack against any single member is treated as an attack against all three.

“Discussions are currently underway to evaluate Syria’s entry into the Makkah alliance,” Al Shaibani said at the Manama Dialogue conference in Bahrain.

Saudi Arabia, under heavy fire from Yemen’s Houthis, is a key backer of Syria’s government that came to power after the fall of former strongman Bashar al-Assad in December 2024.

Pakistan has two defence agreements with Saudi Arabia aimed at collective deterrence: the Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement between the two countries, and the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, which also includes Turkiye.

Pakistan is providing “whatever support is needed” to defend Saudi Arabia amid the Houthi attacks, military spokesperson Lieutenant General Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry said earlier this month.

However, the Inter-Services Public Relations director general also clarified that all members of the Makkah Defence Alliance were “absolutely clear… that this alliance has no offensive intent; it is purely defensive”.

On Friday, Lt-Gen Chaudhry said the wording of the pact did not bar new members, when asked whether Iran could join the agreement.

“Anyone who has a shared vision of collective deterrence and regional peace, why not? Everyone is most welcome,” he said, adding that it was for the political leadership of the three principal parties to decide.

Earlier this month, French President Emmanuel Macron made a surprise visit to Riyadh and said France had sent troops to help shield a key Saudi oil terminal from Houthi attacks.

Also in October, the UK government announced it would deploy British fighter planes to help Saudi Arabia against the attacks.

    <div dir='auto' class='story__content  flow-root    text-4 leading-tight text-black'><p><strong>Iran’s top diplomat on Saturday said there were no plans to hold talks with the United States despite growing concerns over a return to war.</strong></p>
<p>“Currently, there are no plans for meetings with American officials, and any speculation to the contrary is merely media assumption,” Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said in an interview with <em>Al Jazeera,</em> according to the state news agency <em>IRNA.</em></p>
<p>“Under current circumstances, Iran sees no necessity for a meeting with the Americans; Iran’s conditions are clear, and consultations regarding them are ongoing among mediators,” he said.</p>
    <figure class='media  w-full sm:w-1/2  media--right  media--embed  media--uneven' data-original-src='https://english.aaj.tv/news/330478789/irans-supreme-leader-warns-us-israel-against-new-attacks'>

        class="nk-iframe"
        width="100%" frameborder="0" scrolling="no" style="height:250px;position:relative"
        src="https://english.aaj.tv/news/card/330478789"
        sandbox="allow-same-origin allow-scripts allow-popups allow-modals allow-forms"></iframe></div>
        
    </figure>
<p>Araghchi confirmed that Iran received a letter from US Vice President JD Vance, following days of diplomatic efforts to head off a return to violence.</p>
<p>“The message from American Vice President JD Vance has been carefully reviewed and discussed in high-level meetings,” he said.</p>
<p>“If Washington’s objective in sending the message is to sow discord, this would be yet another misstep, adding to America’s previous errors.”</p>
<p>But Araghchi added: “The American side’s effort to open a dialogue and reach a broader understanding is viewed as a positive step.”</p>

        },

            if (direction == 'up' && document.querySelectorAll('article.single').length > 1) {
                window.history.replaceState({}, '', url);
                document.title = title;
            }
        }
    });

    // Sticky ad and refresh
    const stickyAd = document.querySelector('.ad--sticky-refresh');
    if (stickyAd) {
        const sticky = new Waypoint.Sticky({
            element: stickyAd,
            stuckClass: 'fixed top-0'
        });
        const stickyAdId = stickyAd.getAttribute('id');
        document.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
            const items = document.querySelectorAll('article.single:not(.refreshed)');
            if (items.length != 0 && items.length % 3 == 0) {
                for (const item of items) {
                    item.classList.add('refreshed');

                const adSlots = googletag.pubads().getSlots();
                for (i = 0; i < adSlots.length; i++) {

        }
    }
});

headline: Iran has ‘no plans for meetings with American officials’: foreign minister
description: Confirms Vance letter was received and ‘carefully reviewed’ as mediators consult on Iran’s conditions
author: AFP
article_text:
Iran’s top diplomat on Saturday said there were no plans to hold talks with the United States despite growing concerns over a return to war.

“Currently, there are no plans for meetings with American officials, and any speculation to the contrary is merely media assumption,” Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said in an interview with Al Jazeera, according to the state news agency IRNA.

“Under current circumstances, Iran sees no necessity for a meeting with the Americans; Iran’s conditions are clear, and consultations regarding them are ongoing among mediators,” he said.

Araghchi confirmed that Iran received a letter from US Vice President JD Vance, following days of diplomatic efforts to head off a return to violence.

“The message from American Vice President JD Vance has been carefully reviewed and discussed in high-level meetings,” he said.

“If Washington’s objective in sending the message is to sow discord, this would be yet another misstep, adding to America’s previous errors.”

But Araghchi added: “The American side’s effort to open a dialogue and reach a broader understanding is viewed as a positive step.”

                const state = refreshables[id];
                if (!state.armed) continue;
                if (!pageVisible || !state.inView || !state.element.isConnected) {
                    state.dwell = 0;
                    continue;
                }

                state.inViewSeconds++;
                state.dwell++;
                if ((state.viewable || state.empty) && state.inViewSeconds >= state.seconds && state.dwell >= REFRESH_DWELL) {
                    // Disarmed until slotRenderEnded re-arms it, so one refresh per render
                    state.armed = false;
                    state.count++;
                    state.slot.setTargeting('refresh', String(state.count));
                    console.log(new Date().toISOString().substr(11, 8) + ' %crefreshAd%c(' + id + ') #' + state.count + ' after ' + state.inViewSeconds + 's in view ' + state.slot.getAdUnitPath(), 'color: orange;', 'color: initial;');
                    googletag.pubads().refresh([state.slot]);
                }
            }
        }

        function armRefresh(e, element, seconds) {
            const id = element.id;
            let state = refreshables[id];
            if (!state) {
                state = refreshables[id] = { slot: e.slot, element: element, inView: false, count: 0 };
                refreshObserver.observe(element);
            }
            Object.assign(state, { armed: true, seconds: seconds, empty: e.isEmpty, viewable: false, inViewSeconds: 0, dwell: 0 });
            refreshTicker = refreshTicker || setInterval(refreshTick, 1000);
        }

        googletag.pubads().addEventListener('impressionViewable', (e) => {
            const id = e.slot.getSlotElementId();
            const element = document.getElementById(id);
            // data-rendered / data-viewable let page scripts (e.g. english/__js/_header.js) follow a slot's state
            if (element) element.dataset.viewable = 'true';
            const state = refreshables[id];
            if (state) state.viewable = true;
        });

        // Manual, ungated refresh for debugging from the console: refreshAd('div-gpt-ad-...') or refreshAd('/1029551/Dawn-...')
        window.refreshAd = id => googletag.pubads().refresh(
            googletag.pubads().getSlots().filter(slot => slot.getAdUnitPath() === id || slot.getSlotElementId() === id)
        );

        
        
        // <div data-refresh="30" id='div-gpt-ad-1234567890123-0' ...
        // https://developers.google.com/publisher-tag/reference#googletag.events.SlotRenderEndedEvent
        googletag.pubads().addEventListener("slotRenderEnded", (e) => {
            const id = e.slot.getSlotElementId();
            const element = document.getElementById(id);
            if (!element) return;

            const isFilled   = !e.isEmpty;
            const isDebug    = window.__debugAds;
            const hasSize    = e.size && (e.size[0] > 1 || e.size[1] > 1);
            const wantsFloat = element.dataset.floating === 'true' && typeof initFloatingAdUnit === 'function';

            element.dataset.rendered = isFilled ? 'filled' : 'empty';
            delete element.dataset.viewable;

            // Apply visual styling only to ads with real dimensions
            if (isFilled && hasSize) {
                element.classList.add('ad-rendered');
                const renderedClasses = (element.getAttribute('data-rendered-classes') || '').trim();
                if (renderedClasses) element.classList.add(...renderedClasses.split(/\s+/));
            }

            if (isFilled) {
                console.log(new Date().toISOString().substr(11, 8) + ' %cADVERT%c: ' + (e.size ? e.size[0] + ',' + e.size[1] : '1x1') + ' | Id: ' + id + ' | Path: ' + e.slot.getAdUnitPath() + ' | Advertiser: ' + e.advertiserId + ' | LineItem: ' + (e.lineItemId || 'Adx') + ' | Creative: ' + e.creativeId, 'color: orange;', 'color: initial;');
            } else if (isDebug) {
                console.log(new Date().toISOString().substr(11, 8) + ' %cADVERT%c: (empty/debug) | Id: ' + id + ' | Path: ' + e.slot.getAdUnitPath(), 'color: orange;', 'color: initial;');
            }

            if ((isFilled || isDebug) && wantsFloat) {
                initFloatingAdUnit(element);
            }

            // data-smart-refresh / data-refresh: (re)arm the viewability-gated refresh, see refreshTick()
            const seconds = parseInt(element.dataset.smartRefresh || element.dataset.refresh, 10);
            if (seconds > 0) {
                if (isDebug) {
                    console.log(new Date().toISOString().substr(11, 8) + ' %crefreshAd%c(' + id + ') armed: ' + seconds + 's in view ' + e.slot.getAdUnitPath(), 'color: orange;', 'color: initial;');
                }
                armRefresh(e, element, seconds);
            }
        });


        
        // create an array of rendered slots
        // this event is fired only for ads with content, no empty slots (SlotRenderEndedEvent)
        // https://developers.google.com/publisher-tag/reference#googletag.events.SlotOnloadEvent
        googletag.pubads().addEventListener('slotOnload', function(e) {
            const id = e.slot.getSlotElementId(); 
            const slot = document.getElementById(id);
            
            const parent = slot.closest('.ad-sticky-slide');
            if (parent) {
                const height = slot.getBoundingClientRect().height * 1.5;
                parent.style.width = '100%';
                parent.style.height = height + 'px';
                parent.style.backgroundColor = '#fafafa';
                parent.style.marginBottom = '16px';
            }
        });

        googletag.pubads().getSlots().forEach(slot => {
            const divId = slot.getSlotElementId();
            const div = document.getElementById(divId);
            // Prevent collapsing on data-collapse="false"
            if (div && div.dataset.collapse === 'false') {
                slot.setCollapseEmptyDiv(false);
            }
        });
        
        if (__debugAds) {
            function logEventDetails(name, e) {
                const id = e.slot.getSlotElementId(); 
                const slot = document.getElementById(id);
                const isEagerLoaded = slot.dataset.eager === "true";

                console.log('');
                console.log('=============== Event Details ' + name + ' ====================');
                console.log('[AdUnitPath]', e.slot.getAdUnitPath());
                console.log('[Id]', id);
                console.log('[EagerLoaded]', isEagerLoaded);
                console.log('[event]', e);
            }
            googletag.pubads().addEventListener('slotRequested', e => {
                logEventDetails('slotRequested', e);
            });
            googletag.pubads().addEventListener('slotRenderEnded', e => {
                logEventDetails('slotRenderEnded', e);
            });
            
            // debugging is enabled, add bgcolor and padding on all ad divs
            document.querySelectorAll('[id^="div-gpt-ad-"]').forEach(el => {
                var hasError = el.classList.contains('advert-error');
                el.style.backgroundColor = hasError ? '#ecc' : '#ccc';
                el.title = el.dataset.name || '';
                el.innerHTML = hasError ? el.dataset.name : '';
                if (hasError) {
                    el.style.padding = '10px';
                }
                el.style.height = el.dataset.height || '';
                el.style.width = el.dataset.width || '';

                var renderedClasses = (el.getAttribute('data-rendered-classes') || '').trim();
                if (renderedClasses) el.classList.add(...renderedClasses.split(/\s+/));
            });
        } else {
            googletag.pubads().collapseEmptyDivs();
        }
        
    });
    </script>

    <div dir='auto' class='story__content  flow-root    text-4 leading-tight text-black'><p><strong>Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei on Saturday warned the United States and Israel against returning to war, according to a written statement, following threats from the Islamic Republic’s foes of a possible resumption of strikes.</strong></p>
<p>“If the enemies once again launch military or terrorist attacks, it is the armed forces of the Islamic Republic and the Iranian nation that will determine the time and conditions for ending them,” said a statement attributed to Khamenei posted on his website.</p>
<p>The remarks came during a reported meeting between Khamenei and senior military commanders, including armed forces chief of staff Ali Abdollahi, army chief Amir Hatami and Revolutionary Guards commander Ahmad Vahidi. It was the first reported meeting between them.</p>
<p>Khamenei has not been publicly seen since he became supreme leader, following his father Ayatollah Ali Khamenei’s killing in US-Israeli strikes at the start of the Middle East war in February.</p>
    <figure class='media  w-full sm:w-1/2  media--right  media--embed  media--uneven' data-original-src='https://english.aaj.tv/news/330478806/iran-has-no-plans-for-meetings-with-american-officials-foreign-minister'>
        <div class='media__item  media__item--newskitlink  '>    <iframe
        class="nk-iframe"
        width="100%" frameborder="0" scrolling="no" style="height:250px;position:relative"
        src="https://english.aaj.tv/news/card/330478806"
        sandbox="allow-same-origin allow-scripts allow-popups allow-modals allow-forms"></iframe></div>
        
    </figure>
<p>According to the statement, Khamenei ordered the commanders to ensure that “any level or type of threat must be met with an immediate, impactful and geographically unrestricted response”.</p>
<p>It also said that Khamenei ordered the commanders to update Iran’s target list to include “all types of tangible and intangible assets belonging to the American-Zionist enemy”.</p>
<p>The war began on February 28 with US-Israeli strikes on Iran, which swiftly responded with attacks on countries around the region.</p>
<p>The supreme leader’s statement came as fresh diplomatic efforts were underway to avert a resumption of fighting.</p>
<p>A Qatari delegation arrived in Tehran on Friday for talks with Iranian officials, after Iran reportedly received a letter from US Vice President JD Vance.</p>
<p>According to Iranian media, Tehran had yet to respond to the letter.</p>

headline: Iran's supreme leader warns US, Israel against new attacks
description: Written statement says Iran’s armed forces will decide when any new war ends, as diplomacy to avert renewed fighting continues
author: AFP
article_text:
Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei on Saturday warned the United States and Israel against returning to war, according to a written statement, following threats from the Islamic Republic’s foes of a possible resumption of strikes.

“If the enemies once again launch military or terrorist attacks, it is the armed forces of the Islamic Republic and the Iranian nation that will determine the time and conditions for ending them,” said a statement attributed to Khamenei posted on his website.

The remarks came during a reported meeting between Khamenei and senior military commanders, including armed forces chief of staff Ali Abdollahi, army chief Amir Hatami and Revolutionary Guards commander Ahmad Vahidi. It was the first reported meeting between them.

Khamenei has not been publicly seen since he became supreme leader, following his father Ayatollah Ali Khamenei’s killing in US-Israeli strikes at the start of the Middle East war in February.

According to the statement, Khamenei ordered the commanders to ensure that “any level or type of threat must be met with an immediate, impactful and geographically unrestricted response”.

It also said that Khamenei ordered the commanders to update Iran’s target list to include “all types of tangible and intangible assets belonging to the American-Zionist enemy”.

The war began on February 28 with US-Israeli strikes on Iran, which swiftly responded with attacks on countries around the region.

The supreme leader’s statement came as fresh diplomatic efforts were underway to avert a resumption of fighting.

A Qatari delegation arrived in Tehran on Friday for talks with Iranian officials, after Iran reportedly received a letter from US Vice President JD Vance.

According to Iranian media, Tehran had yet to respond to the letter.
